parameters.query: INSERT INTO public.calls (lead_id, omnidim_call_id, agent_id, phone_called, call_status, duration_seconds, recording_url, transcript) VALUES ($1, $2, 'agent_sales_qualifier_01', $3, $4, $5, $6, $7) ON CONFLICT (omnidim_call_id) DO NOTHING;

INSERT INTO public.call_results (call_id, lead_id, call_outcome, interest, website_need, business_goal, timeline, decision_maker, do_not_call, callback_requested, summary) VALUES ((SELECT id FROM public.calls WHERE omnidim_call_id = $1 LIMIT 1), $2, $3, $4::interest_level, $5::website_need_type, $6, $7, $8, $9, $10, $11) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

UPDATE public.leads SET status = $1::lead_status, call_status = 'COMPLETED', interest = $2::interest_level, website_need = $3::website_need_type, business_goal = $4, timeline = $5, last_call_id = $6, last_call_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $7;
INSERT INTO public.do_not_call (phone, reason) VALUES ($1, 'Customer requested DO_NOT_CALL during AI Call') ON CONFLICT (phone) DO NOTHING;
